get.summary: List coordination issues for a project (REST v2.0)
get.description:
Returns a paginated list of coordination issues visible to the user within the project.

Supports `view=ids_only` for `{ "data": [<id>, ...] }` (JSON numbers from `pluck(:id)`).

 Query `included` controls which attributes are present on each item (see schema description).
 Include `permissions` in the query to get `can_edit` field for each issue.

 When `save_sticky_filters` is truthy, list filters may be persisted for the tool (sticky filters).

 **`filters[is_private]`** narrows to public (`false`) or private (`true`) issues. Private-issue
 filtering may be unavailable in some projects, in which case all issues remain public.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: When `ids_only`, response is id list only (no full blueprint objects).

parameters.name: save_sticky_filters
parameters.description: When true, persist current filters for the coordination issues tool where supported.

parameters.name: included
parameters.description:
Comma-separated blueprint field names (e.g. `assignee,title,uuid,location,is_private`). When omitted or empty,
all conditional fields are included.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: filters[assignee_company_id]
parameters.description: Filter item(s) with matching assignee vendor companies.

parameters.name: filters[assignee_id]
parameters.description: Filter item(s) with matching assignee user IDs.

parameters.name: filters[created_by_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) created by the specified User IDs

parameters.name: filters[created_by_company_id]
parameters.description: Filter item(s) with matching created by vendor companies.

parameters.name: filters[created_from]
parameters.description: Filter item(s) by creation source.

parameters.name: filters[ids]
parameters.description: Return only coordination issues with these ids (see `CoordinationIssues::Filter` / `with_ids`).

parameters.name: filters[location_id]
parameters.description: Filters by specific location (Note: Use *either* this or location_id_with_sublocations, but not both)

parameters.name: filters[include_sublocations]
parameters.description: Use together with `filters[location_id]`

parameters.name: filters[search]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) matching the specified search query string.

parameters.name: filters[status]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified statuses

parameters.name: filters[issue_type]
parameters.description: Filter item(s) by issue type.

parameters.name: filters[priority]
parameters.description: Filter item(s) by priority level.

parameters.name: filters[trade_id]
parameters.description: Trade ID

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[due_date]
parameters.description: Filter Coordination Issues by due date.

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort results by field. Direction (asc/desc) controlled by presence or absence of '-' prefix.

parameters.name: filters[overdue]
parameters.description: Filter for overdue Coordination Issues.

parameters.name: filters[document_container_id]
parameters.description: Filter Coordination Issues by document container ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[document_revision_id]
parameters.description: Filter Coordination Issues by document revision ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[coordination_issue_file_id]
parameters.description: Filter by BIM / coordination issue file id(s).

parameters.name: filters[watcher_id]
parameters.description: Filter by watcher user id(s).

parameters.name: filters[is_private]
parameters.description:
Filter by private flag. When the `enable-ci-private` feature is inactive for the project, all issues behave as public
for visibility and this filter has limited effect. Values are booleans (`true` = private, `false` = public).

parameters.name: filters[include_deleted]
parameters.description:
Controls visibility of soft-deleted coordination issues (recycle bin).
- `only`: return only soft-deleted issues
- `with`: return all issues including deleted ones
- omitted (default): return only active issues
Requires `view_deleted_coordination_issue` permission when set.

200.description: OK — paginated issues or ids when `view=ids_only`

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

items.description:
Rendered by `V2::CoordinationIssueBlueprint`. **`id` is always present.** Other keys depend on `included`:
when `included` is omitted or empty, all conditional blueprint fields are serialized; when `included`
lists comma-separated names, only those fields (plus `id`) appear. The BIM file association is keyed
**`bim_file`** (not `coordination_issue_file`). Nested user objects use the identity-with-company shape
(e.g. `email`, `name`).

status.description:
Current status (e.g. `open`, `closed`, `in_progress`). In projects where `in_progress` is unavailable,
issues stored as `in_progress` may serialize as `open`.

is_private.description: Present when `included` contains `is_private` or when `included` is omitted (all fields). Indicates a private coordination issue when `true`.

coordination_issue_type.description:
Configurable issue type record (`CompanyConfigurableBlueprint`: `id`, `name`, `active`, `position`,
`global`, `deletable`, timestamps). Present when `included` contains `coordination_issue_type` or is omitted.

coordination_issue_priority.description:
Configurable priority record (`CompanyConfigurableBlueprint`: `id`, `name`, `active`, `position`,
`global`, `deletable`, timestamps). Present when `included` contains `coordination_issue_priority` or is omitted.

viewpoint_count.description: Number of viewpoints attached to this coordination issue.

coordination_issue_bim_viewpoints.description:
Viewpoint mappings on this issue (`CoordinationIssueBimViewpointBlueprint` view `:normal`). Present when
`included` contains `coordination_issue_bim_viewpoints` or is omitted.

bim_viewpoint_id.description: Linked legacy BIM viewpoint id; null for Model Manager-backed mappings.

is_primary.description: Whether this mapping is the primary viewpoint for the issue.

source_file.description:
Resolved source file for the coordination issue. Returns the document name from
`document_container_metadata` when present, otherwise falls back to the BIM file.

id.description: Document container id or BIM file id.

linked_drawings.description:
Drawing revisions linked via published drawing markup (Coordination Issue pin), same semantics as REST v1
`view=extended`. Omitted unless `included` lists `linked_drawings` or `included` is omitted/empty.

url.description: Deep link to the drawing with focused markup element

drawing_markup_preview_images.description:
Preview images for published drawing markup layers. Omitted unless `included` lists
`drawing_markup_preview_images` or `included` is omitted/empty.

document_snapshots.description:
Document snapshots linked to this coordination issue (`CoordinationIssueDocumentSnapshotBlueprint`
view `:normal`). Present when `included` contains `document_snapshots` or is omitted.

items.description:
Rendered by `CoordinationIssueDocumentSnapshotBlueprint` view `:normal`. Represents a point-in-time
snapshot image of a document revision linked to a coordination issue. The `prostore_file` nested object
provides the file URL, name, content type, and viewable status.

document_container_id.description: The document container (folder) the source document belongs to.

document_name.description:
Human-readable name of the source document. Surfaced as the coordination issue's
source file for outside-workflow (document snapshot) issues. May be null for snapshots
created before this field existed.

document_revision_id.description: The document revision id from which the snapshot was taken.

document_revision_version_id.description: The specific document revision version id for this snapshot.

viewer_doc_id.description:
Identifier for the document viewer type associated with this snapshot. Used to determine
which viewer to use when displaying the document. May be null if not set.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created.

prostore_file.description:
Prostore file object (`ProstoreFileBlueprint` view `:normal_with_viewable`). Contains the snapshot
image file details including a signed URL, content type, and whether the file is viewable.

url.description: Signed download URL for the snapshot file.

viewable.description: Whether this file has a viewable document representation.

permissions.description:
User permissions on this coordination issue. Returned only when `policy_context` is provided
in render options (typically by including the `X-Policy-Context` header or equivalent).

can_edit.description:
Whether the current user can edit (update) this coordination issue. Requires `update_coordination_issue`
permission from the policy AND the workflow (if present) to not be terminated or completed.

can_update_status.description:
Whether the current user can change the issue's status. Present only when the policy supports status
transitions; true when at least one status action is available and the workflow (if present) is active.

data.description: Coordination issue primary keys from `pluck(:id)` (JSON numbers).

x-changelog.summary: Added soft-delete filtering and restore action to coordination issues
x-changelog.description:
The REST v2.0 coordination issues endpoint now supports soft-delete filtering and restore:

* `GET /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/coordination_issues?filters[include_deleted]=only` — List only soft-deleted issues (recycle bin view)
* `GET /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/coordination_issues?filters[include_deleted]=with` — List all issues including deleted
* `GET /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/coordination_issues/{id}?include_deleted=true` — Show a soft-deleted issue
* `POST /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/coordination_issues/{id}/restore` — Restore a soft-deleted issue

The `filters[include_deleted]` and `include_deleted` parameters require `view_deleted_coordination_issue` permission.
The restore action requires `update_deleted_coordination_issue` permission.

post.description:
Creates an issue via `CoordinationIssues::Public::CreateService`. Request body is **flat** JSON
(not wrapped in `coordination_issue`). See create schema for which fields are persisted vs accepted-only.

**`template_id`:** Optional. When provided, the template's `issue_details` are merged as defaults
underneath the explicitly supplied fields. If configurable field validations fail, a 422 response
includes `prefill_data` with the merged template defaults for the client to present to the user.

**`status: in_progress`:** May be unavailable in some projects; when unavailable it is stored as `open`.

**`is_private`:** Optional boolean; when sent, persisted on create (see create request schema).

**`document_snapshot`:** Optional object to associate a document snapshot with the coordination issue.

Observers may enqueue notifications / activity side effects.

schema.description:
Flat request body (not wrapped in `coordination_issue`). Persisted attributes include `title`,
`description`, `status`, `creation_source`, `bim_file_id` (stored as the coordination issue file),
`bim_model_id`, `trade_id`, `location_id`, `assignee_id`, `due_date`, `issue_type`, `priority`,
`coordination_issue_type_id`, `coordination_issue_priority_id`, `company_id`, and **`is_private`**
when sent. Attachments, an optional inline document snapshot, origin, and watchers are created as
associated records.

project_id.description: Path includes project; may be echoed in body (ignored for scoping).

company_id.description: Company id for the new issue (typically matches path company).

description.description: Free-text description of the coordination issue.

status.description:
Initial status. On create, only `open`, `closed`, or `in_progress` are valid. `in_progress` may be
unavailable in some projects, in which case it is stored as `open`.

location_id.description: Location id scoped to the project.

assignee_id.description: Login information / user id for assignee.

bim_file_id.description: BIM file id for the coordination issue file association.

due_date.description: Due date for the coordination issue.

issue_type.description: Issue type label, such as `clash` or `building_code`.

priority.description: Permitted by controller; not applied by `CreateService` — use PATCH to set.

coordination_issue_type_id.description: ID of the configurable coordination issue type to assign.

template_id.description:
Optional template ID. When provided, the template's `issue_details` are used as default values

x-changelog.description:
POST `/rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/coordination_issues` now returns
`422 Unprocessable Entity` with reason code `TEMPLATE_NOT_AVAILABLE` when the requested `template_id`

template the project has switched off, and a shadowed project template. Requests without a `template_id`,
or with a template that is still active for the project, are unaffected.

patch.description:
JSON body may be either:

1. **Nested (recommended):** a **`coordination_issue`** object with attributes to update, or  
2. **Flat:** the same attribute keys at the **root** of the JSON (no `coordination_issue` wrapper).

Updates use `CoordinationIssues::Public::UpdateService`. `bim_file_id` is mapped to the internal file association.

**`status: in_progress`:** Requires `enable-ci-in-progress`; otherwise coerced to `open` before persist.

**`is_private`:** Optional boolean; when sent, persisted on update (see update schema).

oneOf.description:

subject to validations.

coordination_issue.description:
Update payload attributes. When the request uses a nested body, this object appears under `coordination_issue`;
when using a **flat** body, these properties are at the **root** of the JSON (same keys).

Updates are applied with `CoordinationIssues::Public::UpdateService` (subject to validations). `bim_file_id` is
normalized to `coordination_issue_file_id` server-side.

`enable-ci-in-progress` is active (`CoordinationIssue.in_progress_feature_enabled?`). If the feature is off,
the API coerces `in_progress` to `open` before persisting. Response `status` follows `CoordinationIssue#status`
(stored `in_progress` may be represented as `open` in JSON when the feature is off).
